spontaneous_coronary_artery_dissection.text: In patients with spontaneous coronary artery dissection, PCI is recommended only for patients with symptoms and signs of ongoing myocardial ischaemia, a large area of myocardium in jeopardy, and reduced antegrade flow.
spontaneous_coronary_artery_dissection.recommendation: PCI recommended only for patients with ongoing ischaemia, large myocardium at risk, and reduced antegrade flow

thrombus_aspiration.text: The routine use of thrombus aspiration is not recommended.

multivessel_disease_management.text: It is recommended to base the revascularization strategy (IRA PCI, multivessel PCI/CABG) on the patient's clinical status and comorbidities, as well as their disease complexity, according to the principles of management of myocardial revascularization.
multivessel_disease_management.recommendation: Base revascularization strategy on clinical status, comorbidities, and disease complexity (IRA PCI, multivessel PCI/CABG)
